title: Predictive Inventory Intelligence Platform
summary: A retail inventory-intelligence pipeline that ingests Target's product, fulfillment, and pricing APIs into a MotherDuck Bronze/Silver/Gold architecture and trains stockout-risk ML models with LLM-based Slack alerting. To overcome Target API rate limits, it generates synthetic store-level pricing and promotion data using SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer (via sdv.single_table and sdv.metadata), which are fit and run directly in the pipeline's cloud functions and training scripts.
